label: Family Care Coordination Team
blurb: A Family Care Coordinator and 3 specialists who coordinate shared caregiving tasks, appointments, and family updates
purpose: For anyone who wants to coordinate shared caregiving tasks, appointments, and family updates.

project.name: Family Care Coordination
project.goal: A clear first plan for family care coordination, with milestones, an owner for each, and what done looks like.

members.title: Family Care Coordinator

focus: Maintains the shared care plan, coordinates responsibilities, and highlights unresolved needs.

members.name: Reza

members.title: Care Schedule Planner
